summary: Share native and EXL3 trellis preparation with bounded W4A16 workspaces
compatibility: Native TrellisConfig callers remain accepted. Canonical EXL3 callers use trellis_from_exl3 and pass device to prepare_weights. GPU serving qualification is pending.
details: Preserves codewords, FP16 scales and source-global transform coordinates through common trellis preparation.
Retains compact W4A16 trellis decoding and unordered atomic route packing.
Preserves IQ2_XS, IQ2_XXS and Q8_0 epilogues and pipeline tuning.
